name: [📜 NEW SCROLLS] Elementalism
desc:
UPDATE 17: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/update-17-elementalism/4940978?u=cassi_emm

NOTE: You mostly can't do anything to level up in private servers; you just get access to several commands.

Elementalism is an action RPG game with a vast map. Explore, find lost and secret items, master your element (or perhaps specialize in non-elemental classes), fight bosses, build your character, join a nation, win major wars around the servers, get recognized for your skills among the community, or maybe even rule a nation.

Check the allies of the Elementalism group to see nations & LV 2 organizations!

Solo developed project by @cassi_emm with a few contributions from other users.
